Neo-Vedānta
(‘new Vedānta’)
------------------------------------------
Vedānta, the philosophy of the Prasthānatraya—the three basic works viz., the उपनिषद्स्, the Brahmasūtras and the Bhagavadgītā—has branched off into several sub-systems. The teachings of रामकृष्ण and Vivekānanda have tried to synthesise these systems into one coherent philosophy. This is generally called ‘Neo-Vedānta’.
See RĀMAKṚṢṆA and VIVEKĀNANDA.
